answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 22878 Country: India Title: I am farooq from bangalore i am working for citibank credit card collection can i know this work is jayaz to work? Question: I am farooq from bangalore i am working for citibank credit card collection can i know this work is jayaz to work? Answer ID: 22878 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 922/922/M=1431) If your job does not involve interest and there is no other reason that makes it unlawful, then it is lawful; otherwise not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
